boundary: Manual-supported value copying plus a restricted prototype policy. Tests establish offline behavior; no compiler/controller execution or temporary physical-capacity claim.

rules.documented: Constants and expressions pass a temporary copy; parentheses force variable arguments to value passing. STRING formals omit physical length; STR_LEN measures current contents.
rules.implemented: ASCII literals, constants, expressions and grouped STRING variables/fields/elements copy the initialized logical value once into an independent read-only temporary. Values of at most 254 characters, including empty contents, are supported.
rules.restriction: The 254-character input limit is a conservative prototype guard, not evidence of controller temporary allocation or expression-buffer capacity. Uninitialized, non-ASCII and overlong inputs fail before entering the callee.
rules.tests: tests/test_string_values.py: literals, constants, built-ins, fields/elements, snapshot isolation and runtime guards

rules.feature: Potential writes to individual formal parameters
rules.implemented: Assignments, FOR targets and conversion outputs identify direct writes. A fixed-point analysis propagates writes through bare reference arguments, including recursive calls and parameter permutations. Read-only STRING values are admitted only where the target formal has no potential write.
rules.restriction: Flow-insensitive: writes in skipped branches or after RETURN still block the value call. Grouped arguments are separate copies; a grouped STRING passed to a writer is rejected at that nested call. Writes to other formals or unrelated globals do not imply a write to this STRING temporary.
rules.tests: tests/test_string_values.py: direct/transitive/recursive writes, per-formal output isolation and unchanged reference writes

rules.implemented: StringValueReference retains an unspecified physical capacity and rejects both set and clear. Bare nested forwarding retains the same protected cell; grouped forwarding creates another protected copy. Reports record static argument sites and per-formal potential writes/passing modes.
rules.restriction: Runtime object layout is a prototype choice. No public source operation exposes the temporary capacity. Frame cleanup, source-located failures and existing evaluation-order guards remain in force.
